statements.name: int_edge_amount_bit_reads
statements.sql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT
    c.check_id,
    c.group_code,
    c.narrow_key,
    c.wide_key,
    c.amount,
    c.ratio
  FROM rel__stg_edge_amount_checks AS c
),

group_names AS (
  SELECT
    v.group_code,
    v.group_name
  FROM VALUES
    ('G-1', 'Mallard desk'),
    ('G-2', 'Teal desk'),
    ('G-3', 'Eider desk') AS v(group_code, group_name)
),

group_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    c.group_code,
    COUNT(*) AS group_check_count
  FROM checks AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.group_code
),

checks_forward AS (
  SELECT
    k.group_code,
    k.check_id,
    k.amount
  FROM checks AS k
  ORDER BY
    k.check_id
),

checks_backward AS (
  SELECT
    k.group_code,
    k.check_id,
    k.amount
  FROM checks AS k
  ORDER BY
    k.check_id DESC
),

hash_forward AS (
  SELECT
    c.group_code,
    HASH_AGG(c.check_id, c.amount) AS group_hash
  FROM checks_forward AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.group_code
),

hash_backward AS (
  SELECT
    c.group_code,
    HASH_AGG(c.check_id, c.amount) AS group_hash
  FROM checks_backward AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.group_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.check_id,
    FLOOR(c.ratio)::FLOAT AS ratio_floor,
    FLOOR(c.amount, 1)::NUMBER(38, 1) AS amount_floor_tenths,
    BITAND(c.narrow_key, 6)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS narrow_key_bits,
    ZEROIFNULL(c.amount)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS amount_or_zero,
    c.narrow_key::BIGINT AS narrow_key_bigint,
    c.amount::DOUBLE AS amount_double,
    (c.narrow_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.wide_key)::BOOLEAN AS keys_not_distinct,
    EQUAL_NULL(c.narrow_key, c.wide_key)::BOOLEAN AS keys_equal_null,
    n.group_name::VARCHAR AS group_name,
    s.group_check_count::NUMBER(38, 0) AS group_check_count,
    (f.group_hash = b.group_hash)::BOOLEAN AS group_hash_is_order_free
  FROM checks AS c
  INNER JOIN group_sizes AS s
    ON c.group_code = s.group_code,
  group_names AS n,
  hash_forward AS f,
  hash_backward AS b
  WHERE
    n.group_code = c.group_code
    AND f.group_code = c.group_code
    AND b.group_code = c.group_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_edge_amount_statistics
statements.sql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT
    c.check_id,
    c.group_code,
    c.narrow_key,
    c.amount,
    c.fine_amount,
    c.ratio
  FROM rel__stg_edge_amount_checks AS c
),

per_group AS (
  SELECT
    c.group_code,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 0)) AS median_scale_0,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 2)) AS median_scale_2,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 4)) AS median_scale_4,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 10)) AS median_scale_10,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 11)) AS median_scale_11,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount::NUMBER(20, 12)) AS median_scale_12,
    MEDIAN(c.fine_amount) AS median_scale_15,
    MODE(c.amount) AS mode_amount,
    COUNT_IF(c.amount > 0) AS paid_count,
    MAX_BY(c.ratio * 0, c.group_code) AS signed_zero_pick
  FROM checks AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.group_code
),

over_no_rows AS (
  SELECT
    MODE(c.amount) AS mode_over_no_rows,
    MEDIAN(c.amount) AS median_over_no_rows,
    COUNT_IF(c.amount > 0) AS paid_count_over_no_rows
  FROM checks AS c
  WHERE c.check_id IS NULL
),

having_only AS (
  SELECT MODE(c.narrow_key) AS mode_with_having_only
  FROM checks AS c
  WHERE c.check_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 0
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    g.group_code,
    g.median_scale_0::NUMBER(38, 3) AS median_scale_0,
    g.median_scale_2::NUMBER(38, 5) AS median_scale_2,
    g.median_scale_4::NUMBER(38, 7) AS median_scale_4,
    g.median_scale_10::NUMBER(38, 13) AS median_scale_10,
    g.median_scale_11::NUMBER(38, 14) AS median_scale_11,
    g.median_scale_12::NUMBER(38, 15) AS median_scale_12,
    g.median_scale_15::NUMBER(38, 18) AS median_scale_15,
    g.mode_amount::NUMBER(18, 2) AS mode_amount,
    g.paid_count::NUMBER(38, 0) AS paid_count,
    g.signed_zero_pick::FLOAT AS signed_zero_pick,
    n.mode_over_no_rows::NUMBER(18, 2) AS mode_over_no_rows,
    n.median_over_no_rows::NUMBER(38, 5) AS median_over_no_rows,
    n.paid_count_over_no_rows::NUMBER(38, 0) AS paid_count_over_no_rows,
    h.mode_with_having_only::NUMBER(18, 0) AS mode_with_having_only
  FROM per_group AS g
  CROSS JOIN over_no_rows AS n
  CROSS JOIN having_only AS h
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_edge_analysis_patterns
statements.sql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    l.sku,
    l.line_no
  FROM rel__stg_edge_basket_lines AS l
),

dated AS (
  SELECT MIN(TRY_TO_DATE(d.date_text, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS first_date
  FROM rel__stg_edge_date_texts AS d
),

own_names AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    MAX(l.line_no) AS line_no
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.basket_id
),

positional AS (
  SELECT
    $1 AS basket_id,
    MIN($2) AS positional_sku
  FROM lines
  GROUP BY
    1
),

unnamed AS (
  SELECT
    basket_id,
    line_no + 1,
    line_no::VARCHAR
  FROM lines
),

unnamed_per_basket AS (
  SELECT
    u.basket_id,
    MAX(u."LINE_NO + 1") AS next_line_no,
    MIN(u."LINE_NO::VARCHAR") AS line_no_text
  FROM unnamed AS u
  GROUP BY
    u.basket_id
),

counted AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    LEFT(MIN(l.sku), 5)::VARCHAR(5) AS sku_prefix,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.basket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.basket_id,
    LAST_DAY(d.first_date, month)::DATE AS month_end,
    n.line_no,
    p.positional_sku::VARCHAR AS positional_sku,
    u.next_line_no::NUMBER(38, 0) AS next_line_no,
    u.line_no_text::VARCHAR AS line_no_text,
    c.sku_prefix,
    c.line_count
  FROM counted AS c
  CROSS JOIN dated AS d
  LEFT JOIN own_names AS n
    ON c.basket_id = n.basket_id
  LEFT JOIN positional AS p
    ON c.basket_id = p.basket_id
  LEFT JOIN unnamed_per_basket AS u
    ON c.basket_id = u.basket_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

WITH lines AS (

statements.name: int_edge_basket_tag_sets
statements.sql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    l.tag
  FROM rel__stg_edge_basket_lines AS l
),

baskets AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(l.tag) AS tags
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.basket_id
),

flattened AS (
  SELECT
    b.basket_id,
    f.value::VARCHAR AS tag
  FROM baskets AS b, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => b.tags) AS f
),

flattened_tags AS (
  SELECT
    f.basket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS flattened_count,
    LISTAGG(DISTINCT f.tag, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.tag) AS flattened_tags
  FROM flattened AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.basket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    b.basket_id,
    ARRAY_SIZE(b.tags)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS tag_count,
    ARRAY_CONTAINS('gift'::VARIANT, b.tags)::BOOLEAN AS has_gift,
    ARRAYS_OVERLAP(b.tags, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('pond', 'garden'))::BOOLEAN AS overlaps_pond_or_garden,
    ARRAY_SIZE(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_CAT(b.tags, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('gift')))
    )::NUMBER(38, 0) AS distinct_tag_count,
    ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_CAT(b.tags, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('gift'))))::ARRAY AS distinct_tags,
    COALESCE(t.flattened_count, 0)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS flattened_count,
    t.flattened_tags::VARCHAR AS flattened_tags
  FROM baskets AS b
  LEFT JOIN flattened_tags AS t
    ON b.basket_id = t.basket_id
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_edge_basket_top_tags
statements.sql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT
    l.line_id,
    l.basket_id,
    l.sku,
    l.tag
  FROM rel__stg_edge_basket_lines AS l
),

baskets AS (
  SELECT
    l.basket_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(l.tag) AS tags
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.basket_id
),

by_position AS (
  SELECT
    b.basket_id,
    b.tags
  FROM baskets AS b
  ORDER BY
    2 DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

by_name AS (
  SELECT b.basket_id
  FROM baskets AS b
  ORDER BY
    b.tags DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

through_iff AS (
  SELECT
    b.basket_id,
    IFF(TRUE, b.tags, b.tags) AS tags
  FROM baskets AS b
  ORDER BY
    2 DESC
  LIMIT 1
),

over_union AS (
  SELECT
    b.basket_id,
    b.tags
  FROM baskets AS b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'B-0' AS basket_id,
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('aaa') AS tags
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 1
),

constructed AS (
  SELECT
    l.line_id,
    ARRAY_CONSTRUCT(l.sku) AS skus
  FROM lines AS l
  ORDER BY
    2,
    1
  LIMIT 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    'by_position' AS pick_kind,
    p.basket_id AS picked_id,
    ARRAY_SIZE(p.tags)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS picked_size
  FROM by_position AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'by_name' AS pick_kind,
    n.basket_id AS picked_id,
    NULL::NUMBER(38, 0) AS picked_size
  FROM by_name AS n
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'through_iff' AS pick_kind,
    i.basket_id AS picked_id,
    ARRAY_SIZE(i.tags)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS picked_size
  FROM through_iff AS i
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'over_union' AS pick_kind,
    u.basket_id AS picked_id,
    ARRAY_SIZE(u.tags)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS picked_size
  FROM over_union AS u
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'constructed' AS pick_kind,
    c.line_id AS picked_id,
    ARRAY_SIZE(c.skus)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS picked_size
  FROM constructed AS c
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_edge_category_walk
statements.sql:
WITH links AS (
  SELECT
    l.category_id,
    l.parent_id,
    l.category_name
  FROM rel__stg_edge_category_links AS l
),

shelves AS (
  SELECT l.shelf_depth AS level
  FROM rel__stg_edge_category_links AS l
),

deepest AS (
  SELECT MAX(s.level) AS level
  FROM shelves AS s
),

walk AS (
  SELECT
    k.category_id,
    LEVEL AS walk_depth,
    CONNECT_BY_ROOT k.category_name AS root_name,
    SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(k.category_name, ' > ') AS category_path
  FROM links AS k
START WITH k.parent_id IS NULL
CONNECT BY k.parent_id = PRIOR k.category_id
),

joined_walk AS (
  SELECT
    k.category_id,
    d.level AS joined_level,
    CONNECT_BY_ROOT k.category_name AS joined_root_name
  FROM links AS k
  CROSS JOIN deepest AS d
START WITH k.parent_id IS NULL
CONNECT BY k.parent_id = PRIOR k.category_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.category_id,
    w.walk_depth::NUMBER(38, 0) AS walk_depth,
    w.root_name::VARCHAR AS root_name,
    w.category_path::VARCHAR AS category_path,
    j.joined_level::NUMBER(38, 0) AS joined_level,
    j.joined_root_name::VARCHAR AS joined_root_name,
    (
      SELECT MAX(level)
      FROM shelves
    )::NUMBER(38, 0) AS deepest_shelf
  FROM walk AS w
  INNER JOIN joined_walk AS j
    ON w.category_id = j.category_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

WITH profiles AS (

  FROM rel__stg_edge_customer_profiles AS p
),

blocked AS (

  FROM rel__edge__customer_profiles AS s
  WHERE s.loyalty_tier = 'BLOCKED'
),

passes_not_in AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id
  FROM profiles AS p
  WHERE
    p.customer_id NOT IN (
      SELECT b.customer_id
      FROM blocked AS b
    )
),

passes_not_exists AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id
  FROM profiles AS p
  WHERE
    NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT 1
      FROM blocked AS b
      WHERE b.customer_id = p.customer_id
    )
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    (
      i.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ) AS passes_not_in,
    (
      e.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ) AS passes_not_exists
  FROM profiles AS p
  LEFT JOIN passes_not_in AS i
    ON p.customer_id = i.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN passes_not_exists AS e
    ON p.customer_id = e.customer_id
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_edge_customer_matches
statements.sql:
WITH profiles AS (

    p.customer_id,
    p.full_name,
    p.previous_full_name,
    p.partner_order_number
  FROM rel__stg_edge_customer_profiles AS p
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    EDITDISTANCE(LOWER(p.full_name), LOWER(p.previous_full_name))::INT AS name_edit_distance,

statements.name: int_edge_join_keys
statements.sql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT
    c.check_id,
    c.group_code,
    c.narrow_key
  FROM rel__stg_edge_amount_checks AS c
),

check_groups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.group_code
  FROM checks AS c
  WHERE c.group_code <> 'G-3'
),

group_names AS (
  SELECT
    v.group_code,
    v.group_name
  FROM VALUES
    ('G-1', 'Mallard desk'),
    ('G-2', 'Teal desk'),
    ('G-9', 'Eider desk') AS v(group_code, group_name)
),

desks AS (
  SELECT v.desk_code
  FROM VALUES ('G-1'), ('G-7') AS v(desk_code)
),

thresholds AS (
  SELECT
    v.threshold_key,
    v.threshold_name
  FROM VALUES (10, 'ten or more'), (100, 'a hundred or more') AS v(threshold_key, threshold_name)
),

right_using AS (
  SELECT
    'right_using' AS join_shape,
    group_code,
    n.group_name,
    NULL AS threshold_name
  FROM check_groups AS g
  RIGHT JOIN group_names AS n
    USING (group_code)
),

natural_joined AS (
  SELECT
    'natural' AS join_shape,
    n.group_code,
    n.group_name,
    NULL AS threshold_name
  FROM check_groups AS g
  NATURAL JOIN group_names AS n
),

later_outer AS (
  SELECT
    'using_then_right' AS join_shape,
    group_code,
    n.group_name,
    d.desk_code AS threshold_name
  FROM check_groups AS g
  INNER JOIN group_names AS n
    USING (group_code)
  RIGHT JOIN desks AS d
    ON n.group_code = d.desk_code
),

asof_matched AS (
  SELECT
    'asof:' || c.check_id AS join_shape,
    c.group_code,
    NULL AS group_name,
    t.threshold_name
  FROM checks AS c
  ASOF JOIN thresholds AS t MATCH_CONDITION (c.narrow_key >= t.threshold_key)
),

all_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM right_using
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM natural_joined
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM later_outer
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM asof_matched
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      a.join_shape || ':' || COALESCE(a.group_code, '-') || ':' || COALESCE(a.threshold_name, '-')
    )::VARCHAR AS row_key,
    a.join_shape::VARCHAR AS join_shape,
    a.group_code::VARCHAR AS group_code,
    a.group_name::VARCHAR AS group_name,
    a.threshold_name::VARCHAR AS threshold_name
  FROM all_rows AS a
)

FROM final

WITH lines AS (

    l.line_id,

  FROM rel__stg_edge_basket_lines AS l
),

baskets AS (

filtered AS (
  SELECT
    'where' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    l.line_id AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE l.tag = 'bath'
),

first_lines AS (
  SELECT
    'qualify' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    l.line_id AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.basket_id ORDER BY l.line_no, l.line_id) = 1
),

busy AS (
  SELECT
    'group_by_position' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    NULL AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    2
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),

counted AS (
  SELECT
    'group_by_all' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    COUNT(*)::VARCHAR AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY ALL
),

lowest_sku AS (
  SELECT
    'order_by_limit' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    l.line_id AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  ORDER BY
    l.sku,
    l.line_id
  LIMIT 1
),

with_gift AS (
  SELECT
    'exists_filter' AS decider,
    b.basket_id,
    NULL AS detail
  FROM baskets AS b
  WHERE
    EXISTS(
      SELECT 1
      FROM lines AS g
      WHERE
        g.basket_id = b.basket_id
        AND g.tag = 'gift'
    )
),

gift_flags AS (
  SELECT
    'exists_output' AS decider,
    b.basket_id,
    (
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM lines AS g
        WHERE
          g.basket_id = b.basket_id
          AND g.tag = 'gift'
      )
    )::VARCHAR AS detail
  FROM baskets AS b
),

sku_parts AS (
  SELECT
    'flatten_input' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    l.line_id || '#' || f.index::VARCHAR AS detail
  FROM lines AS l, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => SPLIT(l.sku, '-')) AS f
),

rolled AS (
  SELECT
    'rollup_position' AS decider,
    l.basket_id,
    GROUPING(l.tag)::VARCHAR || ':' || COALESCE(l.tag, '~') || '=' || COUNT(*)::VARCHAR AS detail
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (
      2,
      l.tag
    )
),

without_pond AS (
  SELECT l.basket_id
  FROM lines AS l
  EXCEPT
  SELECT l.basket_id
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE l.tag = 'pond'
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 1
),

remaining AS (
  SELECT
    'except_limit' AS decider,
    w.basket_id,
    NULL AS detail
  FROM without_pond AS w
),

all_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM filtered
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM first_lines
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM busy
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM counted
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM lowest_sku
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM with_gift
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM gift_flags
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM sku_parts
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM rolled
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM remaining
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      a.decider || ':' || COALESCE(a.basket_id, '-') || ':' || COALESCE(a.detail, '-')
    )::VARCHAR AS decider_row,
    a.decider::VARCHAR AS decider,
    a.basket_id::VARCHAR AS basket_id,
    a.detail::VARCHAR AS detail
  FROM all_rows AS a
)

statements.sql:
WITH loaded AS (

    v.value_id,
    v.group_code,
    v.sort_key,
    v.attribute_value,
    v.value_text
  FROM rel__stg_edge_variant_values AS v
),

typed AS (
  SELECT
    l.value_id || '-DATE' AS value_id,
    l.group_code,
    l.sort_key + 100 AS sort_key,
    TO_VARIANT(TRY_TO_DATE(l.attribute_value::VARCHAR)) AS attribute_value,
    l.value_text
  FROM loaded AS l
  WHERE
    IS_VARCHAR(l.attribute_value)
    AND TRY_TO_DATE(l.attribute_value::VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.value_id || '-TIMESTAMP' AS value_id,
    l.group_code,
    l.sort_key + 200 AS sort_key,
    TO_VARIANT(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(l.attribute_value::VARCHAR)) AS attribute_value,
    l.value_text
  FROM loaded AS l
  WHERE
    IS_VARCHAR(l.attribute_value)
    AND TRY_TO_DATE(l.attribute_value::VARCHAR) IS NOT NULL
),

all_values AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM loaded
  UNION ALL BY NAME
  SELECT *
  FROM typed
),

with_note AS (
  SELECT
    v.value_id,
    v.group_code,
    v.sort_key,
    v.attribute_value,
    v.value_text AS "note"
  FROM all_values AS v
),

partitioned AS (
  SELECT
    a.value_id,
    a.group_code,
    a.sort_key,
    a.attribute_value,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.group_code, a.attribute_value) AS partition_size,
    OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(* EXCLUDE ("note")) AS object_without_note
  FROM with_note AS a
),

group_picks AS (
  SELECT
    a.group_code,
    MIN_BY(a.attribute_value, a.sort_key) AS group_first_value,
    MAX_BY(a.attribute_value, a.sort_key) AS group_last_value,
    ARRAY_SIZE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT a.attribute_value)) AS group_distinct_elements
  FROM all_values AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.group_code
),

distinct_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.group_code,
    a.attribute_value
  FROM all_values AS a
),

distinct_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.group_code,
    COUNT(d.attribute_value) AS group_distinct_rows
  FROM distinct_values AS d
  GROUP BY
    d.group_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      l.value_id || '~' || r.value_id
    )::VARCHAR AS pair_id,
    l.attribute_value AS left_value,
    r.attribute_value AS right_value,
    (
      l.attribute_value = r.attribute_value
    )::BOOLEAN AS values_equal,
    EQUAL_NULL(l.attribute_value, r.attribute_value)::BOOLEAN AS values_equal_null,
    l.partition_size::NUMBER(38, 0) AS left_partition_size,
    (
      TYPEOF(g.group_first_value) || ' ' || TO_JSON(g.group_first_value)
    )::VARCHAR AS group_first_value,
    (
      TYPEOF(g.group_last_value) || ' ' || TO_JSON(g.group_last_value)
    )::VARCHAR AS group_last_value,
    c.group_distinct_rows::NUMBER(38, 0) AS group_distinct_rows,
    g.group_distinct_elements::NUMBER(38, 0) AS group_distinct_elements,
    IFF(
      IS_OBJECT(l.attribute_value) OR IS_ARRAY(l.attribute_value),
      NULL,
      l.attribute_value
    )::VARCHAR AS left_scalar_text,
    TO_JSON(l.object_without_note)::VARCHAR AS left_object_without_note
  FROM partitioned AS l
  INNER JOIN partitioned AS r
    ON l.group_code = r.group_code
    AND l.sort_key < r.sort_key
  INNER JOIN group_picks AS g
    ON l.group_code = g.group_code
  INNER JOIN distinct_counts AS c
    ON l.group_code = c.group_code
)

FROM final

statements.name: rpt_edge_stock_reconciliation
statements.sql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT
    e.sku,
    e.warehouse_code,
    e.quantity,
    e.status
  FROM rel__stg_edge_ledger_entries AS e
),

allocated AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS allocated_units
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE UPPER(l.status) = 'ALLOCATED'
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
),

counted AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS counted_units
  FROM lines AS l
  WHERE UPPER(l.status) = 'COUNTED'
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    warehouse_code,
    a.allocated_units::NUMBER(38, 0) AS allocated_units,
    c.counted_units::NUMBER(38, 0) AS counted_units,
    (
      COALESCE(c.counted_units, 0) - COALESCE(a.allocated_units, 0)
    )::NUMBER(38, 0) AS variance_units
  FROM allocated AS a
  FULL OUTER JOIN counted AS c
    USING (sku, warehouse_code)
)

FROM final

statements.name: stg_edge_ticket_notes
statements.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__edge__ticket_notes
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.note_id,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.body, 'DS-O-\\d+')::VARCHAR AS first_order_ref,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.body, $$DS-O-\d+$$)::VARCHAR AS first_order_ref_dollar,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.body, 'DS-O-(\\d+)', 1, 2, 'e', 1)::VARCHAR AS second_order_number,
    (
      s.body RLIKE 'DS-O-\\d+'
    )::BOOLEAN AS mentions_order_rlike,
    REGEXP_LIKE(s.body, '.*ds-o-\\d+.*', 'is') AS mentions_order_regexp_like,
    REGEXP_COUNT(s.body, 'DS-O-\\d+')::INT AS order_ref_count,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.body, 'refund(ed)?', 1, 1, 'i')::VARCHAR AS refund_word,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(s.body, '\\s+', ' ')::VARCHAR AS body_collapsed,
    // A backslash-escaped quote inside a single-quoted literal, then a macro call to expand
    CONTAINS(s.body, 'O\'Brien')::BOOLEAN AS quotes_customer,
    UPPER(TRANSLATE(
  REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(s.sku), '\\s+', ''),
  '_',
  '-'
)) AS sku_canonical,
    SPLIT_PART(s.tags_text, '#', 2)::VARCHAR AS second_hash_tag,
    (
      s.utm_source ILIKE ANY ('%mail%', 'news%')
    ) AS is_newsletter_visit,
    (
      NOT s.discount_code LIKE ANY ('TEST%', 'STAFF%')
    ) AS is_customer_code,
    s.discount_code LIKE '50!%%' ESCAPE '!' AS is_fifty_percent_code,
    SPLIT_PART(s.sku, '-', 0)::VARCHAR AS sku_part_zero,
    SPLIT_PART(s.sku, '-', -1)::VARCHAR AS sku_part_last,
    SPLIT_PART(s.sku, '-', 5)::VARCHAR AS sku_part_beyond,
    SPLIT_PART(s.sku, '', 1)::VARCHAR AS sku_part_no_delimiter,
    SUBSTR(s.sku, 0, 3)::VARCHAR AS sku_from_zero,
    SUBSTR(s.sku, -2)::VARCHAR AS sku_last_two,
    SUBSTR(s.sku, -10, 3)::VARCHAR AS sku_before_start,
    s.body,
    s.tags_text
  FROM src AS s
)

FROM final
